recorded.prompt:q-calendar: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-calendar: "Whenever a period is given by its first and last unit, the size is last − first + 1." Weeks 5 to 7: start 5, size 3.
recorded.prompt:q-shop-size: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-shop-size: "one NoOverlap per resource, one precedence row per consecutive pair of steps": that is 3 machines, and 4 jobs × 2 pairs = 8 rows.
recorded.prompt:q-shared: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-shared: "CP-SAT accepts the model and proves its optimum, but ... every job occupies both crews at once"

recorded.prompt:q-calendar:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-calendar:a: "Writing size 13 − 12 = 1 blocks week 12 only and lets a job run in week 13." This is the same off-by-one: size 2 leaves week 7 open.
recorded.prompt:q-calendar:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-calendar:c: The span [s, e) "covers weeks s, s+1, …, e−1", so size 7 blocks weeks 5 to 11. That is more than the three weeks.
recorded.prompt:q-calendar:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-calendar:d: The span [s, e) starts at week s, so a start of 7 blocks weeks 7 to 9 and leaves weeks 5 and 6 free.
recorded.prompt:q-shop-size:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shop-size:a: "every machine gets a NoOverlap". The count is one per machine (3), not one per job.
recorded.prompt:q-shop-size:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shop-size:b: "every machine gets a NoOverlap". That gives 3, not 12.
recorded.prompt:q-shop-size:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shop-size:d: "one precedence row per consecutive pair of steps". Three steps make 2 rows per job, so 8 in total, not 12.
recorded.prompt:q-shared:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shared:b: "an interval in two NoOverlap lists is present in both, so it would occupy both crews."
recorded.prompt:q-shared:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shared:c: "one interval in both crews' lists: OPTIMAL, makespan 19 weeks"
recorded.prompt:q-shared:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shared:d: "CP-SAT accepts the model". "A wrong model is still a valid model".
